name: Super Hero Obby 🦸
desc:
⚠️ The game is currently in BETA, if you see any bugs please report them to us and we'll fix them immediately! ⚠️

✨Welcome to easy Super Hero Obby!

💪 Become a hero and conquer different challenges! This fun, colorful easy obby needs a champion like yourself to save the day!

⚡Abilities:
Super Punch: Break down walls to get across the stage!
Super Shrink: Become tiny and squeeze through any gaps!
Super Jump: Jump super high to get across a stage!
X-Ray Vision: Invisible parts will become visible!
Time Freeze: Stop time to help you complete stages!
Fly: Fly around freely!
 
❤️ Made by Obby Chefs!
